description: Single-hop delegation happy path (aitp/0.3 compact-JWS shape). A (kat-keypair-001) peer-issued a TCT and companion grant voucher to B (kat-keypair-002) with grants [read_data, write_data]. B delegates scope [read_data] (a strict subset) to C (kat-keypair-003) by minting a delegation JWS (typ aitp-delegation+jwt) with iss=B, sub=C, aud=A, cnf.jkt = C's RFC 7638 thumbprint, embedding A's grant voucher verbatim as the `voucher` claim. A verifies the outer JWS under B's Manifest key, the voucher under its own key (voucher.iss = A's AID, voucher.sub = outer iss = B), the audience, the expiry monotonicity (exp <= voucher.exp), and the scope subset (scope ⊆ voucher.grants). All checks pass; A would mint a fresh peer-issued TCT for C carrying the delegated subset. (RFC-AITP-0006 §4.) The success counterpart to del-003-scope-exceeded. Manifest source: `input.issuer_manifests` carries B's (kat-keypair-002) signed Manifest, and the outer JWS verifies under the key that Manifest designates (RFC-AITP-0006 §4 step 1, RFC-AITP-0007 §1). This fixture supplies no revocation snapshot, so it does not test revocation: its expected outcome assumes "not revoked" (see the conformance README, "Revocation inputs").
